decision_summary: Implement v0.6.29 as a narrow Trial and Infrastructure Uncertainty release in the calibration package.
rationale: Visionary: quality comparisons must expose nondeterminism before confidence can earn empirical meaning. Builder: add one canonical trial-variance record linked to calibration runs and suite health, with reproducible statistics and infrastructure profiles. Guardian: trial count, low variance, narrow ranges, or a passing verifier must never become quality claims; example evidence stays provisional and unresolved confounders route to governance.
recommendation: Proceed with schema, verifier, fixtures, example, calibration-readiness regression, authoring guidance, roadmap, and release evidence; defer framework learning.
